Event

Savage! Inferno Rally

Win the race or stay trapped in hell forever! In this lawless land swarming with villains, a ruthless rally begins... fight fire with fire!

Activity TypeGveInfernoRallyPhases3Duration7 or 8 days

Across all phases

GameplayEvent Rules10 sections
Basic Gameplay

◆ During the Savage! Inferno Rally event, you can team up to explore and take on challenges.

◆ Exploring consumes stamina, with the ultimate goal of clearing all areas to claim their rewards.

Team Rules

◆ During team formation, you can create, join, leave, or disband teams.

◆ Creating a team is free the first time; subsequent creations require crystals.

Rally Racing

◆Transcender Power = [Total Power (outside of events) * (1 + Soulfires Bonus ‰ + Motorcycle Bonus ‰ + Fellow Skill Bonus %) + Soulfires Fixed Bonus] * (1 + Power Boost Bonus %)

◆ Challenging different areas consumes varying amount of stamina.

◆ Stamina regenerates over time: 1 point every 20 minutes, stopping at the cap. Can use items to instantly restore stamina.

◆ Challenges may trigger random events. Completing them can get buffs or soulfires.

◆ Buffs temporarily increase your power for upcoming battles.

◆ Soulfires boost Transcender Power during the event, stack infinitely for power gains, disappear after the event ends.

Motorcycle

◆ Win challenges to earn Motorcycle EXP. Get enough to level up your motorcycle (up to 15 levels).

◆ Motorcycle has 3 forms: Default (Lv1), Stage 2 (Lv6), Stage 3 (Lv11).

◆ Motorcycle can boost your power by a percentage. Higher levels grant greater bonuses.

◆ Motorcycle level resets after the event ends.

Mark Enemies

◆ Mark powerful enemies to request team assistance.

◆ You can only mark one enemy at a time.

◆ Marked enemies show in team support list. Defeat them to earn point rewards.

Level Map

◆ Clear specified challenges to unlock new levels.

◆ The Inferno Rally has five levels, each with three difficulty modes.

◆ Higher levels yield more points and rewards but have tougher enemies and high stamina costs.

Demon Eggs

◆ You can collect Demon Eggs and Incusyrum during exploration.

◆ Use the matching Incusyrum to hatch Demon Eggs and claim rewards.

◆ Unhatched demon eggs are cleared after the event ends. Incusyrum units are kept.

First-Clear Reward

◆ Clearing an level for the first time grants a reward.

◆ Use a Double Voucher to claim an extra reward.

◆ Unused Double Vouchers expire at the end of the event, but an extra reward will be sent via mail.

◆ All levels share identical first-clear rewards.

Hell Arena

◆ Transcenders reaching the Shadow Canyon and defeating Red-fluff Bat once can enter the Hell Arena and be matched against opponents of similar rank.

◆ Select one Fellow to fight alongside you; each Fellow can fight only once per day.

◆ Fellow ATK = Fellow Power; Fellow HP = Fellow Power.

◆ After selecting your Fellow, purchase power-boosting items from sponsors.

◆ In each battle round, choose 1 of your opponent's 3 Fellows to challenge. Winning grants another chance to buy power-boosting items.

◆ Soulfires collected in exploration also boost your power in the Hell Arena.

◆ Victories earn points and improve your ranking.

◆ Defeating all three challengers sent by the opponent grants win streak rewards. At the end of the battle, Transcenders also receive settlement rewards.

Leaderboard and Rewards

◆ Ranking: The Personal Ranking is based on the personal score accumulated by each Transcender during the event period. The Team Ranking is based on the total score accumulated by each Transcender in the team during the event period.

◆ Rewards: After the event ends, claim the corresponding ranking rewards based on the Personal Ranking and Team Ranking.
